svg.title: Hostile patterns finish
svg.desc: Across 112 ReDoS cases, Mica::Regex is 8.8 times as fast on warm search (330.1 ns vs 2.91 µs) and hits no limit; PCRE2 with JIT stopped on its match or JIT stack limit 28 times and timed out once. All 13 ReDoS families finish within 1,000 ms, with growth slopes from 0.81 to 1.0.
